```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = TRUE, message = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here("bn_learning"))
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(bnlearn)
```

# 1. Load config

```{r load-config}
source(params$config)
cat(sprintf("Network: %s (seed=%d)\n", NETWORK_ID, SEED))
cat(sprintf("Roots: %s\n", paste(ROOTS, collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("Continuous nodes: %d\n", length(CONTINUOUS_MAP)))
cat(sprintf("Log-transform: %s\n", paste(LOG_TRANSFORM, collapse = ", ")))
```

# 2. Load baseline data

```{r load-data}
bn_raw <- read_csv(
  file.path("..", "data", "processed", "bn_ready_baseline.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
stopifnot(nrow(bn_raw) == 92)
cat(sprintf("Loaded bn_ready_baseline.csv: %d x %d\n", nrow(bn_raw), ncol(bn_raw)))
```

# 3. Backfill CMV from raw metadata

CMV IgG serology was measured at non-baseline visits for 83/92 subjects.
CMV serostatus is a stable trait — backfill from whichever visit has the measurement.

```{r backfill-cmv}
meta_raw <- read_csv(
  file.path("..", "data", "raw", "sound_life_labs_metadata.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

cmv_lookup <- meta_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(cmv.igg_serology_interpretation)) %>%
  distinct(subject.subjectGuid, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(subject.subjectGuid, cmv_backfill = cmv.igg_serology_interpretation)

# Verify all 92 subjects have CMV
stopifnot(all(bn_raw$subject.subjectGuid %in% cmv_lookup$subject.subjectGuid))

# Verify no conflicts (each subject has exactly one status)
n_status <- meta_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(cmv.igg_serology_interpretation)) %>%
  group_by(subject.subjectGuid) %>%
  summarise(n_unique = n_distinct(cmv.igg_serology_interpretation), .groups = "drop")
stopifnot(all(n_status$n_unique == 1))

# Merge and overwrite
bn_raw <- bn_raw %>%
  left_join(cmv_lookup, by = "subject.subjectGuid") %>%
  mutate(cmv.igg_serology_interpretation = cmv_backfill) %>%
  select(-cmv_backfill)

cat(sprintf("CMV after backfill: %d non-NA / %d\n",
            sum(!is.na(bn_raw$cmv.igg_serology_interpretation)), nrow(bn_raw)))
cat("CMV distribution:\n")
print(table(bn_raw$cmv.igg_serology_interpretation, useNA = "ifany"))
```

# 4. Select and rename nodes

```{r select-nodes}
# Build column selection: full csv name -> short alias
col_selection <- NODE_MAP  # named vector: alias = csv_col

# Verify all columns exist in data
missing_cols <- setdiff(col_selection, names(bn_raw))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(sprintf("Columns not found in data: %s", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
}

# Select and rename
bn_df <- bn_raw %>%
  select(all_of(unname(col_selection))) %>%
  rename(!!!setNames(unname(col_selection), names(col_selection)))

cat(sprintf("Selected %d columns (aliases): %s\n",
            ncol(bn_df), paste(names(bn_df), collapse = ", ")))
```

# 5. Apply log1p transforms

```{r log-transform}
if (length(LOG_TRANSFORM) > 0) {
  for (var in LOG_TRANSFORM) {
    stopifnot(var %in% names(bn_df))
    bn_df[[var]] <- log1p(bn_df[[var]])
    cat(sprintf("  log1p(%s): range [%.2f, %.2f]\n",
                var, min(bn_df[[var]], na.rm = TRUE), max(bn_df[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)))
  }
}
```

# 6. Set factor levels for discrete roots

```{r factor-roots}
for (root in ROOTS) {
  ref <- REFERENCE_LEVELS[[root]]
  lvls <- sort(unique(bn_df[[root]]))
  # Put reference level first
  lvls <- c(ref, setdiff(lvls, ref))
  bn_df[[root]] <- factor(bn_df[[root]], levels = lvls)
  cat(sprintf("  %s: levels = %s (ref = %s)\n",
              root, paste(levels(bn_df[[root]]), collapse = ", "), ref))
}
```

# 7. Complete-case analysis

```{r complete-case}
n_before <- nrow(bn_df)
per_col_missing <- colSums(is.na(bn_df))
if (any(per_col_missing > 0)) {
  cat("Per-column missingness (non-zero only):\n")
  for (nm in names(per_col_missing[per_col_missing > 0])) {
    cat(sprintf("  %s: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\n",
                nm, per_col_missing[nm], n_before, 100 * per_col_missing[nm] / n_before))
  }
}

bn_complete <- bn_df[complete.cases(bn_df), ]
n_after <- nrow(bn_complete)
cat(sprintf("\nComplete cases: %d / %d (dropped %d)\n", n_after, n_before, n_before - n_after))

# Warn if losing more than 15% of samples
if ((n_before - n_after) / n_before > 0.15) {
  warning(sprintf("Dropping %.1f%% of samples — consider imputation or excluding high-missingness columns",
                  100 * (n_before - n_after) / n_before))
}
```

# 8. Summary and export

```{r export}
cat(sprintf("Final data: %d samples x %d nodes (%d roots + %d continuous)\n",
            nrow(bn_complete), ncol(bn_complete),
            length(ROOTS), ncol(bn_complete) - length(ROOTS)))
cat(sprintf("Root balance:\n"))
for (root in ROOTS) {
  cat(sprintf("  %s:\n", root))
  print(table(bn_complete[[root]]))
}

# Save analysis-ready data
out_path <- file.path("output", "models", sprintf("%s_data.rds", NETWORK_ID))
saveRDS(bn_complete, out_path)
cat(sprintf("\nSaved: %s\n", out_path))

# Also save the node mapping for traceability
mapping_df <- data.frame(
  alias = names(NODE_MAP),
  csv_column = unname(NODE_MAP),
  type = ifelse(names(NODE_MAP) %in% ROOTS, "discrete_root", "continuous"),
  log_transformed = names(NODE_MAP) %in% LOG_TRANSFORM,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write_csv(mapping_df, file.path("output", sprintf("%s_node_mapping.csv", NETWORK_ID)))
cat(sprintf("Saved node mapping: output/%s_node_mapping.csv\n", NETWORK_ID))
```
